verdict.rationale: Conductor is a coding-agent orchestration app that handles users' code and prompts, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documented control or policy letting users opt out of AI model training. A developer's remark that messages run through the user's local Claude Code installation describes data flow, not an opt-out capability. Community comments note there is no visible disclosure of data practices.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
